answer: Route reputation as flow through a trust graph where every edge has a small, fixed capacity. A newcomer gains standing only through vouches from established agents, and each voucher can pass on a limited amount. A sybil cluster may build an endless spiral of fake agents vouching for each other, but all of that trust still has to enter through the few real edges linking it to honest agents, so its total stays capped no matter how many names it makes. One honest seed acts as a beacon, and trust spreads outward slowly, like a glacier, so a sudden swarm stands out.
